description: This Python script automates the documentation generation for plugins based on changes in source files, JSON outputs, and headers within a project. It includes functions for validating JSON change consistency, determining plugins to process, generating documentation from headers and JSON outputs, post-processing markdown files, and updating the documentation sidebar.

methods.name: get_plugin_from_path(file_path)
methods.description: Extracts plugin name from a given file path, handling different directory structures.

methods.name: validate_json_changes(changed_files)
methods.description: Ensures that all JSON changes in the 'apis/' directory have corresponding output files in 'tools/md_generator/json/'.

methods.name: get_plugins_to_process(changed_files)
methods.description: Identifies which plugins need documentation processing based on changed files, categorizing by file type.

methods.name: generate_docs_for_plugin(plugin_name, file_types, logfile=None)
methods.description: Generates documentation for a specific plugin, handling header files and JSON outputs, with error handling.

methods.name: postprocess_md()
methods.description: Performs post-processing on generated markdown files, cleaning up specific markup.

methods.name: update_sidebar()
methods.description: Runs an external script to update the documentation sidebar.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates validation, plugin processing, documentation generation, post-processing, and sidebar updating based on command-line arguments.
